description.value: Bespoke & Sushi is a Marpole-neighbourhood Japanese eatery specializing in Aburi (flame-seared) Oshi sushi and fully customizable Bespoke Bowls, offering a contemporary take on affordable Japanese dining. The menu spans nigiri, sashimi, signature rolls, ramen, udon, and donburi, earning strong ratings across hundreds of reviews. It sits on West 73rd Avenue in Vancouver's south end, making it a convenient refuelling stop for cyclists on routes through Marpole.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The zomi.menu website confirms the business is open, matches OSM name/address/phone, and explicitly offers a pickup option confirming takeout. The menu lists multiple vegetarian items (Veggie Spring Roll, Yam Tempura Roll, Edamame, Mango-Avocado Roll, Yam & Avocado Roll). No evidence on the website or in OSM tags addresses bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-specific infrastructure.
concerns: Website is a third-party ordering platform (zomi.menu) rather than a dedicated business website; no independent business site is available to cross-check deeper details.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open Japanese restaurant with confirmed address, phone, and active online ordering. A useful food stop for cyclists in the Marpole area.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes Veggie Spring Roll, Yam Tempura Roll/Cone, Yam & Avocado Roll, Mango-Avocado Roll, Edamame, and Agedashi Tofu
